Presenting DUNIYA KA MELA MELE MEIN LADKI FULL VIDEO SONG from RAJA JANI movie starring Dharmendra, Hema Malini, Premnath, Prem Chopra, Johnny Walker, Sajjan, Bindu and Helen in lead roles, released in 1972. The song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar, Kishore Kumar and music is given by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: DUNIYA KA MELA MELE MEIN LADKI
Singer: LATA MANGESHKAR
Music Director: LAXMIKANT-PYARELAL
Lyricist: ANAND BAKSHI
